For successive CA integers 3≤N≤n≤N′, f(n)≤max(f(N),f(N′)), where f(n)=σ(n)/(n log log n). RH is not needed for the local proof.
Under ¬RH, for every b∈(1−Θ,1/2), f(n)/e^γ−1=Ω±((log n)^−b) along CA integers, where Θ=sup Reρ.
For any fixed B, RH iff the Lagarias inequality holds for all CA integers n≥B. Under ¬RH, positive CA excess dominates Lagarias slack O(n/log n).
